targets.note: Earliest SBI web capture found (Wayback has exactly one snapshot of this URL, 1998-12-03). Page's own '4.RESIDENT AND NRO DEPOSITS' table, w.e.f. 01 May 1998. The generic table reader would misread this page (it stops at the first parseable table, which is the NRE one, and hardcodes residency 'resident'), so a custom parser reads the page's own section headings instead -- see backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts.
Same 1998-12-03 capture and table as the fd target above; the page states 'RESIDENT AND NRO DEPOSITS' carry one shared rate schedule, so the identical rows are also stored tagged residency nro.
Same 1998-12-03 capture, the page's separate '3.NRE RUPEE DEPOSITS' table, w.e.f. 01 May 1998.

Wayback has exactly one snapshot of this URL, 2001-02-15. Page's own table, headed 'Effective from 12th Sept. 2000'; the generic reader parses the rows fine but cannot read that date on its own (abbreviated month with a trailing period) -- see sbi/2001-product-page in backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts.

Same 2001-02-15 capture and table as the fd target above. SBI's own Recurring Deposit page from the same capture (statebankofindia.com/statebank/sbinew/recurrdeposits.htm) states plainly: 'earn interest on the whole amount at Term deposit rates' -- i.e. the bank's own stated policy is that RD tracks the TDR schedule, so these identical rows are also stored as SBI's RD rates for this date.

State Bank of Mysore's own 'Interest Rates on Domestic Term Deposits' table, 8 monthly captures 2003-10-27..2004-12-12 with several distinct digests (rates actually change across them). Generic table reader handles this page's own '(wef DD/MM/YYYY)' dates and rows without a custom parser. The page also has NRE savings, NRE term, FCNR and RFC sections further down (not domestic, and FCNR/RFC have no matching Product value / no currency dimension in RateRow) -- not pursued in this pass.

State Bank of Patiala's own 'Interest Rates on Deposits' table, 5 monthly captures 2003-04-14..2004-12-05 (a same-URL uppercase variant sbp.co.in/INTERESTRATE.HTM has 4 more captures interleaved across the same span, not pursued separately in this pass). This table splits rates by deposit amount (below/above Rs 15 lakh) plus a third derived-yield column -- see state-bank-of-patiala/2003-portal in backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts. The same page also carries housing-loan/PLR/agriculture-advance *lending* rates further down, out of scope here.

Bank of Baroda's own domestic-deposit table on this page, monthly captures 2002-02-04..2007+, spanning two layouts: 2002's 'DOMESTIC TERM DEPOSITS, NON-RESIDENT (ORDINARY) AND NON-RESIDENT SPECIAL RUPEE(NRSR) DEPOSITS' table (bare leading Sr.No column, amount bands below/15-lacs-to-1-crore, later expanding a third 5-crore-and-above band) and mid-2003's restyled 'Domestic Term & NRO Deposits' table (no Sr.No column, amount bands below/15-lacs-to-5-crore, a derived Annualised Yield column per band). IMPORTANT: this one target/parser combines both eras deliberately -- collectors/src/store.ts's replaceArchiveCards keys a target's stored cards purely by (bankSlug, product, sourceUrl), so two separate targets sharing this same URL/product would each wipe out the other's cards on every re-run (confirmed live). See bank-of-baroda/interest-asp in backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts (a thin wrapper trying the 2002 parser then the 2003+ one; both stay individually registered/tested under their own keys too).

Same captures/table/two-era wrapper as the fd target above; both layouts' headings state the schedule covers domestic (resident) AND non-resident-ordinary deposits together, so identical rows are also stored tagged residency nro.

Same captures/table/two-era wrapper; the 2002-era layout's third, open-ended 'Rs. 5 crore & above' amount band (present by 2002-10-12, not yet present on 2002-02-04) is stored here as fd_bulk. Captures whose table only has finite-upper-bound bands (including the whole 2003+ era, which was not observed to carry a third band) correctly report no rows for this product, not an error.

Bank of India's own domestic rupee term-deposit page, linked from the bank's top-level Interestrate.aspx hub (itself just a nav page, not a rate table). 7 monthly captures 2009-04-13..2012-03-15, all distinct digests. Table splits into three amount bands (<15 lacs / 15 lacs-<1 crore / >=1 crore) and several captures further split each band into '(Existing)'/'Revised' sub-columns -- only 'Revised' is read, dated from that cell's own w.e.f., not the page's separate news-ticker date. The below-1-crore bands are stored here as fd; see the fd_bulk target below for the >=1 crore band. See bank-of-india/2009-rupeetermdeposit in backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts.
Same captures and table as the fd target above; the table's own open-ended 'Rs.1 crore & above' band, stored separately as fd_bulk.

State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur's own 'Revised Interst Rate on Domestic Term Deposit' table (the bank's own misspelling), 18 monthly captures 2001-03-02..2006-05-05 with 8+ distinct digests. Four deposit-size bands (Normal Rates for <15 lacs, then three 'Differential Rates on Single Deposits Only' bands: 15 lacs-<1 crore, 1 crore-<5 crore, 5 crore & above), each differential cell printing the rate plus its delta over the Normal rate in one cell, e.g. '5.50 (0.50)' -- the delta suffix is stripped before reading the rate. Below-1-crore bands stored here as fd; see the fd_bulk target below for the two >=1 crore bands. First predecessor bank in this group with any staged card. See state-bank-of-bikaner-and-jaipur/2001-domestic-term-deposit in backfill/wayback/parsers/psb-a.ts.
Same captures and table as the fd target above; the two 1-crore-and-above differential-rate bands, stored as fd_bulk.
